name: Plant Pathology 2021: Multi-Label Foliar Disease of Apples Benchmark
description: The Plant Pathology 2021 dataset is a large-scale agricultural visual benchmark organized by Cornell AgriTech, Cornell University, and the CVPR 2021 Fine-Grained Visual Categorization (FGVC8) workshop. Expanding significantly upon the 2020 release (which had 3,651 images in 4 classes), the 2021 edition provides 18,632 expertly curated and verified high-resolution images of apple tree leaves photographed in commercial orchards across North America. The dataset models complex multi-label co-occurring disease symptoms across 12 diagnostic states, including apple scab, cedar apple rust, frogeye leaf spot, powdery mildew, and severe mixed infections.
